import boto3, sys, time
from botocore.exceptions import ClientError
ts = time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ', time.gmtime())
ddb = boto3.client('dynamodb', region_name='us-east-1')
results = {}
for prefix in ('RUNTIME', 'POLICY'):
    pk = f"{prefix}#probe-og-i5-{ts}"
    try:
        ddb.put_item(TableName='gateway-access-state-table', Item={'pk': {'S': pk}, 'sk': {'S': 'AC9'}}, ConditionExpression='attribute_not_exists(pk)')
        results[prefix] = 'SUCCESS pk=' + pk
    except ClientError as e:
        results[prefix] = e.response['Error']['Code'] + ' pk=' + pk
for k, v in results.items():
    print(f'{k}: {v}')
